name: git
description: git 설치 여부와 프로젝트 폴더의 git 저장소 상태를 사이드바 섹션에 보여 주고, git 설치 창과 git init을 버튼으로 실행한다.

commands.name: git.install
commands.description: Runs xcode-select --install through the declared program, which opens the system dialog that installs the command line developer tools that provide git. Returns null; a failed run is refused with its text.

commands.name: git.init
commands.description: Runs git init in the project folder through the declared program, then checks the state again. Returns null; a failed run is refused with its text.

commands.name: git.check
commands.description: Checks again whether git is installed and whether the project folder is a git repository, and shows the result in the section. Returns null.

status.name: git.state
status.description: The last check of the section: whether git is installed and its version, whether the project folder is inside a git repository, its branch (null for a detached HEAD), and the text of a failed check. null before the first check ends.

element.name: git.status.install
element.description: The button of the git section that runs git.install while git is missing.

element.name: git.status.init
element.description: The button of the git section that runs git.init while the project folder is not a git repository.

element.name: git.status.check
element.description: The button of the git section that runs git.check.
